author: Where
body:
IGN: LaneGraves (Banned as: Where)

This certain ban on your network has been my first, and I felt that I should appeal because I'd really like to play more. I did use hacks to gain an advantage and should be punished accordingly, but I feel that I should be given a second chance to redeem myself and become a better player. The ban given to me was permanent and I'd appreciate if it was changed to a temporary ban. I enjoy playing on this network and regret the mistake I made. The date of my ban was June 16, 2016.

Thank you.

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey LanGraves!
I'm afraid we don't appeal valid  punishments for hacking until you have been banned for 6-8 months
Please appeal again after that time

Appeal Denied
I will lock once requested or in 24 hours.
